_about.purpose: Held-out set. The system was never tuned against these.
_about.excluded: every section used as a key by data/eval/questions.json
_about.key_derivation: The key is the section the question was generated from. The question was written by reading that section, so that section answers it by construction - the key is mechanical, not a judgement about what a complete answer requires.
_about.limitation: Generated from text by a model, so these are better posed than real user questions. This measures generalisation to unseen material, not to unseen users.
